summary: Ledger authority, full-record validation, quarantine/index recovery, shared locking, auth/API boundaries, and malformed KPI no-post behavior passed review. One cache integrity finding remains.

findings.description: The ledger snapshot uses dev, inode, size, and mtime only. A same-size mutation with restored mtime bypasses authoritative ledger revalidation and returns cached events instead of quarantining the corrupt ledger.
findings.required_change: Include an authoritative content digest or equivalent revalidation in the snapshot and add a same-size, same-inode, same-mtime regression test.

evidence_boundary: No live Slack post was performed; Slack behavior was verified through automated HTTP contract tests.
